acquisition method: The data-dependent instrument method consisted of MS1 (R = 60000) using an AGC target of 3e6, followed by up to 15 MS/MS scans (R = 15,000) of the most abundant ions detected in the preceding MS scan.
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 buffer (pH 8.0) at room temperature in the dark for 20 min.
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 buffer (pH 8.0) at room temperature in the dark for 20 min.
cleavage agent: Following SDS gel electrophoresis, b5 was digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides were analyzed by high-resolution mass spectrometry (Table S1).
collision energy: higher-energy collisional dissociation collision energy was set to 28% nce.
fragmentation method: higher-energy collisional dissociation collision energy was set to 28% nce.
instrument: Peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), equipped with a nanoelectrospray ionization source.
ionization type: Peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), equipped with a nanoelectrospray ionization source.
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced in-gel with 4.5 mM DTT in 100 mM NH4HCO3 buffer (pH 8.0) at 55 °C for 20 min
